features: Video & Audio: Catvision box supports almost all audio and video formats and 4K video decoding, giving an enhanced visual experience.
High Clarity 4K HDR: Catvision Android Box supports 4K Ultra HD resolution with H.265 decoding technology. Enjoy a high-quality viewing experience.

2GB RAM 16GB ROM: Catvision Android Box is loaded with 2GB RAM, 16GB Flash Memory which ensures the box runs stably and smoothly to load movies, pictures and games. In addition, you can also extend the memory through microSD card or USB device.
Processor & OS: Powered by the Android 10 OS which has a stronger stability and faster process speed. You can download apps from Google Play Store/App Store. Runs fast and smooth.

Wi-Fi Connectivity: The box has built-in Dual Band Wi-Fi and supports 10/100M RJ-45 Ethernet. Its wider coverage and faster loading speed avoid the problem of mutual interference while ensuring a stable network environment.

BIS Certified Safety: Complies with Bureau of Indian Standards for electrical safety. Equipped with protection against overcurrent, short circuits, overcharging, over-discharging, and high voltage—ensuring safe and reliable performance. (BIS No-R-93035920)
